desc:
👾 HORDE DEFENDERS 👾

Tens of thousands of alien bugs flood across the map like a living tide, piling into chokepoints and climbing over their own dead to reach your outpost.

Your towers never pick a target. Every one fires exactly where YOU aim it. Aim well and one howitzer shreds a column. Aim badly and the swarm walks right past.

🎯 Aim every tower. Your aim IS the strategy.
🏗️ 18 towers, from sentries and railguns to barricades, barbed wire and tar lobbers.
🦾 Heroes: let the Warden, Marksman or Sentinel fight on their own, or take control and play as them.
🚀 Drone strikes, meteors, ripsaws, salvos and stasis fields.
⛰️ High ground gives your guns more range and damage.
🗺️ 59 levels across 5 alien worlds, each with its own boss.
🏆 Challenges, Endless mode and leaderboards.
🛠️ Build and share your own maps in the Workshop.

⚠️ ALPHA: expect bugs.
